indicators.title: Announced M&A deal value
indicators.why: Deals are announced months before close, locking in advisory and financing fees well ahead of reported revenue.
indicators.source: LSEG Deals Intelligence monthly M&A review
indicators.note: No confirmed public time series; LSEG publishes press-release summaries only.

indicators.title: IPO pipeline — S-1 filing counts
indicators.why: Registration filings precede pricing by ~1-3 months, signaling ECM fee flow before it books.
indicators.note: EDGAR API is public but a filing-count pipeline is not yet built.

indicators.title: High-yield bond issuance
indicators.why: HY windows open and shut quickly; issuance surges/shutdowns lead DCM fees and flag shifts in credit risk appetite.
indicators.note: SIFMA publishes free research; a clean public time series is unconfirmed.

indicators.title: IB fee league-table trackers
indicators.why: Fee estimates from announced/completed deals publish weeks before banks' quarterly filings.
indicators.source: LSEG Deals Intelligence quarterly IB Review
indicators.note: Press-release summaries only; no public series.

indicators.title: MOVE Index (rates implied vol)
indicators.why: Implied Treasury vol reprices ahead of policy surprises and duration-driven deleveraging.
indicators.note: Licensed index; no free public daily series confirmed.

indicators.title: US High Yield OAS
indicators.why: HY spreads price default/liquidity risk months before realized defaults.

indicators.title: US Investment Grade OAS
indicators.why: IG spread companion to HY; investment-grade stress gauge.

indicators.title: Agency MBS spread (30Y mortgage − 30Y Treasury)
indicators.why: MBS widening signals dealer balance-sheet constraints and convexity-hedging pressure before broad funding stress.

indicators.title: WTI crude spot
indicators.why: Real-economy demand signal orthogonal to the heat map's price/stock quarterly metrics.
indicators.note: Calendar spread (prompt − 12M futures) needs a futures curve; spot is the verified public component.

indicators.title: CBOE equity put/call ratio
indicators.why: Options-positioning extremes flag crowded sentiment 1-several weeks before price turns.
indicators.note: Free historical CSV frozen at 2019-10-04; current data requires scraping the daily page.

indicators.title: Cyclically adjusted P/E vs 10-yr mean
indicators.why: Starting valuation is the most robust predictor of medium-horizon returns.
indicators.note: Yale file unreachable/stale as of 2026-10; no confirmed current public series.

indicators.title: US IPO + follow-on issuance volume
indicators.why: Treasurers time equity supply to peak demand; issuance surges cluster near cycle tops.
indicators.note: Free charts; a clean public time series is unconfirmed.

indicators.title: High-beta minus low-vol 60-day relative strength
indicators.why: Rotations into high-beta leadership precede broad index turns as late-cycle risk appetite peaks.
indicators.note: Needs a reliable free ETF price feed; tested sources are bot-walled.

segments.title: Asset & Wealth Management
segments.subtitle: Flows, cash parking, market beta, private markets

indicators.title: Net flows to long-term mutual funds & ETFs
indicators.why: Redemption/allocation shifts move AUM and fee bases weeks before reported revenue.
indicators.note: ICI publishes weekly Excel workbooks; direct download URL unconfirmed (page is bot-walled).

indicators.title: Money-market fund total assets
indicators.why: Sharp MMF inflows signal flight-to-cash and liquidity hoarding, presaging risk-asset outflows.

indicators.title: S&P 500 level
indicators.why: Market beta drives most AUM change; drawdowns lead AUM erosion and fee declines.

indicators.title: 3M CP–OIS spread
indicators.why: CP is the marginal unsecured funding market; spreads reprice within days as risk appetite erodes.
indicators.source: Constructed: Fed commercial paper rates − 3M OIS
indicators.note: No confirmed public 3M OIS series; spread cannot be built from verified inputs.

indicators.title: 3M×3M FRA–OIS spread
indicators.why: Prices forward unsecured term-funding risk plus embedded bank counterparty credit.

indicators.title: FINRA margin debt (debit balances)
indicators.why: Client leverage builds/unwinds ahead of forced deleveraging; peaks precede volatility cascades.

indicators.title: Dealer 5Y senior CDS (average)
indicators.why: Market-implied default intensity of counterparties widens before CVA losses or rating actions.
